raw_html: [[Sound and Silence]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Sound and Silence]]:''' When true power is spoken, weaker beings cannot refute it. Your offensive spells and attacks have a small chance to cause 10d20 Sonic Damage to nearby enemies and [[Silenced|Silence]] them. Each target can negate the Silence on Will save vs DC 90.
